projects.title: Prepera
projects.tagline: AI-powered job-search platform — resume optimization, interview coaching, and salary negotiation, from saved job to signed offer.
projects.description:
## Overview

Prepera is an AI-powered job-search platform that guides job seekers from their first saved listing all the way to a signed offer — combining job discovery, application tracking, and AI coaching in one product.

## Key Features

- **Job discovery & AI matching** — search listings aggregated from major job boards, matched to your profile and experience.
- **Visual job tracker** — a drag-and-drop Kanban pipeline (Saved → Applied → Screening → Interview → Offer) with email sync to auto-capture recruiter communication.
- **AI resume optimization** — tailor your resume to each role and get past applicant tracking systems.
- **Interview coaching & salary negotiation** — practice tools and guidance to walk in confident and maximize your offer.

## Stack

Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and LLM integrations.

projects.title: AuthMatch AI
projects.tagline: HIPAA-regulated AI co-pilot that matches prior-authorization cases to Medicare coverage policy and surfaces the met / not-met criteria.
projects.description:
## Overview

AuthMatch AI is a HIPAA-regulated co-pilot for utilization-management reviewers who process insurance prior authorizations. It matches each case (HCPCS/CPT code + member state) to the controlling Medicare coverage policy (NCD/LCD, MAC-jurisdiction-aware) and extracts the cited *Met / Not Met / Indeterminate* criteria from clinical documentation — with a licensed human reviewer signing off on every case.

## Built for compliance

Targets CMS-0057-F turnaround requirements (7-day standard, 72-hour expedited) taking effect January 2026.

## Architecture

- **web** — Next.js reviewer UI; a thin proxy that handles no PHI and makes no LLM calls.
- **api** — FastAPI service that does all PHI processing, the LLM gateway, OCR, guideline matching, and criteria extraction.
- **supabase** — Postgres schema, row-level-security policies, and an audit-log trigger on every access.

## Stack

Next.js, FastAPI / Python, Supabase/Postgres, and LLMs — designed around strict PHI isolation and auditability.

projects.title: Dupar's BBQ
projects.tagline: Full-stack catering site — mobile menu, multi-step quote builder with Stripe-deposit checkout, and an owner admin dashboard.
projects.description:
## Overview

A full-stack catering website for Dupar's BBQ, a Houston-area BBQ operation. It replaces a static PDF menu with a mobile-friendly storefront and turns phone-and-voicemail ordering into a self-serve quote-and-deposit flow — while giving the owner a dashboard to manage it all.

## Key Features

- **Browsable menu** with photos and current pricing, built for mobile.
- **Multi-step quote builder** so customers can request event catering in minutes.
- **Stripe-deposit checkout** to lock in bookings.
- **Owner admin dashboard** to manage menu, quotes, and orders.
- **Automated notifications** by email (Resend) and SMS (Twilio).

## Stack

Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Stripe, Resend, and Twilio.

projects.title: Angie Cares
projects.tagline: Marketing and intake site for a special-education parent-advocacy practice — clear services, consultation scheduling, and an online intake flow for families.
projects.description:
## Overview

A marketing and intake website for Angie Cares, a special-education parent-advocacy practice. It helps parents and caregivers of children with disabilities, learning differences, and behavioral or mental-health concerns understand the available services, see what an engagement looks like, and get started — through consultation scheduling and an online intake flow.

## Key Features

- **Clear services overview** — parent advocacy, IEP/504 guidance, special-education support, and resource navigation, so families know what to expect.
- **Consultation scheduling & intake form** — a streamlined path from first visit to a booked conversation.
- **Training & workshop booking** plus a parent-resources section.
- **Email notifications** on new inquiries.

## Stack

Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Resend, and Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Gen4Me
projects.tagline: Turns a one-line idea into a tailored CLAUDE.md, a research-backed PRD, and a drift audit — grounded in your real stack.
projects.description:
## Overview

Gen4Me generates the documentation AI coding agents actually follow. From a one-line description of your project, it produces a tailored CLAUDE.md, a research-backed PRD, a build PLAN, and per-directory rules — then audits an existing CLAUDE.md for drift as your code moves.

## How it works

1. **Describe** — one line about your project.
2. **Research** — live web research fills in the gaps about your stack.
3. **Enrich** — confirm assumptions, not boilerplate.
4. **Generate** — CLAUDE.md, PRD, PLAN, and per-directory rules.
5. **Audit** — catch drift between your docs and your code over time.

## Stack

Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, and LLMs — with live web research grounding every document in your real stack.

projects.title: SanctionsWatch
projects.tagline: SaaS platform that monitors regulatory sanctions changes across international jurisdictions, with AI-powered analysis and alerts for compliance teams.
projects.description:
## Overview

SanctionsWatch is a SaaS platform that helps compliance teams stay ahead of fast-moving regulatory sanctions. It continuously monitors sanctions changes across international jurisdictions and uses AI to surface what matters — turning scattered regulatory updates into clear, actionable alerts.

## Key Features

- **Cross-jurisdiction monitoring** — track sanctions changes across multiple international regulatory bodies in one place.
- **AI-powered analysis** — automatically summarize and assess the impact of each change so teams don't have to parse raw regulatory text.
- **Alerts for compliance teams** — timely notifications when relevant updates land, keeping organizations audit-ready.

## Stack

Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, Tailwind CSS, and LLM integrations.

projects.title: G2 Complaint Miner
projects.tagline: CLI tool that scrapes G2 reviews, classifies complaints with Claude, and scores AI product opportunities.
projects.description:
## Overview

G2 Complaint Miner is a command-line tool for finding product opportunities hiding in customer complaints. It scrapes reviews from G2, uses Claude to classify and categorize the complaints, and scores the resulting gaps as potential AI product opportunities.

## Key Features

- **Automated review scraping** — pull reviews for target products directly from G2.
- **AI complaint classification** — use Claude to categorize and structure unstructured review text into actionable complaint themes.
- **Opportunity scoring** — rank recurring pain points to highlight the most promising AI product opportunities.

## Stack

TypeScript, Node.js CLI, Claude API, and Postgres.

bio: I'm a full-stack software engineer who builds and ships AI-powered products end to end — taking ideas from a blank repo to live SaaS, owning the database, backend, AI integration, and front-end.

My work spans regulated healthcare AI (AuthMatch, a HIPAA prior-authorization co-pilot), consumer AI (Prepera, an AI job-search platform), and full-stack commerce (a catering site with Stripe checkout and an owner dashboard). I work primarily in TypeScript and Python — Next.js, FastAPI, Supabase/Postgres, Stripe, and LLMs like Claude and GPT.
Through my studio, NightPivot, I also design AI automation workflows for growing businesses. I'm open to full-time engineering roles and freelance projects — the fastest way to reach me is email.
